summary: Discovered and fixed systematic poisoning of auto-tuner by tester Ollama noise. T1 accuracy recovered from 33.9% to correct routing.
fixes_applied: backtest.js: filter source=mooter-tester events from tuning pipeline
classify.js: 4 context-aware overrides (regex, explain, pkg.json read, translate)
patterns.js: +5 MED_RISK (how should we handle, review this approach, qual a melhor, não funcionar, not working)
validation-set.json: +10 gold labels (review #1: 5 T0/T1, review #2: 5 T2)
root_cause: backtest.js ingested 3839 tester events including Ollama meta-prompts as real user prompts, learning 48 toxic promote-to-T0 patterns that pulled T2 debug/investigate/compare prompts down to T0
